summary: Phase 1 Glassmorphism TWEAKS (iteration 3) visually + computationally verified on design/glassmorphism-phase1 branch. All 3 requested tweaks pass plus all prior Phase 1 effects remain intact. (1) Navbar fully REVERTED to dark navy — fixed top bar uses bg-[#000000]/50 (computed oklab(0 0 0 / 0.5) = rgba(0,0,0,0.5)), all nav text rgb(255,255,255) white, desktop search is solid white pill (bg-white rounded-4xl, computed rgb(255,255,255) / 32px radius), mobile menu hamburger renders white on dark nav, and mobile menu search classes match spec (bg-white border border-primary001 rounded-4xl — code-verified at Header.tsx:425). Bottom-left .app-orb-2 unchanged at rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.06). Regression checks on /howitworks, /howtosell, /about, /events all PASS — gradient background present, orb1@0.12 + orb2@0.06 visible, dark navy nav (oklab(0 0 0 / 0.5)) consistently applied across all routes, glass Safe/Easy/Fair cards and 4 'Buying Tickets Made Simple' cards still render with glass effect. Login page (AuthLayout) correctly unaffected.

critical_code_review_comments: All three tweaks implemented cleanly and match spec exactly.

Find Events border uses inline style for the 0.15 alpha — fine; could alternatively be a Tailwind arbitrary class like `border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.15)]` for consistency, but inline style is perfectly acceptable.

Pre-existing issues NOT caused by this change (same as iteration 2): (a) React DOM warnings for kebab-case SVG props (stroke-width, clip-path, fill-rule, clip-rule, stroke-miterlimit, stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin) — should be camelCased; (b) nested <a> inside <a> hydration error on HomePage Banner (LinkWithRef inside LinkWithRef); (c) React Query functions returning undefined on /events (trending, events/festivals, events/by-groupe, events/concerts, venues/best, popular-events) causing 'Something went wrong' — these are backend/data issues, not glassmorphism related.

All Phase 1 effects (gradient, orbs, glass cards, pill buttons) intact across /, /howitworks, /howtosell, /about, /events. Login page (AuthLayout) correctly unaffected. Mobile hamburger drawer open was flaky in headless playwright (3-attempt loop-prevention) — code verified at Header.tsx:425 matches spec.
